caption:
I’m 87 years old and I’ve never stepped foot in a hospital, not even once.

#usahealth #wellness #usa #newyork #american #chinesemedicineworks #wellnessjourney
transcript: I'm 87 years old and I've never stepped foot in a hospital, not even once. All because of these four things I do every day. First, every morning before food, before noise, before the world begins to rush, I drink hot water. It gently wakes the body and supports the organs. Second, I move my body daily, not to punish it, not to chase youth, but to keep the blood flowing and the energy alive. Third, I eat simply and stop before I am full. When the body is not overloaded, it has space to heal itself. Fourth, I protect my peace. I do not rush through life. I do not carry unnecessary stress or anger. A calm mind keeps the body strong. Health is not built in a hospital. It is built quietly, in the small choices you repeat every day. If this message spoke to you, comment, heal below so I know you're listening. And if you're ready to go deeper, my 30-day healing journey and my e-books are waiting for you in the link on my profile.
